_readme: Games that come ready for co-op. Each entry is applied once per install, the first time the game is downloaded or launched, and never over an online-mode choice already made. See gamePresets.js.

To add one: copy an entry, set the Steam appid and name, list its steps, then publish an update (dev/release.cjs). A step added to an existing entry later reaches installs that already had the others.
Steps: online = real Steam session under Spacewar (Valheim also gets its adapter); peakMod = PEAK join-a-friend plugin; photonMod = generic join-a-friend engine for Unity/Photon games.

presets.name: Valheim
presets.note: Online mode with the Valheim adapter: host or join friends through Steam.

presets.name: PEAK
presets.note: Online mode, plus the join-a-friend plugin (F7 at the main menu) for friends who own the real game.
